title: 第一卷 第19章 媚毒第一卷 第20章 题词
lines: 片刻后，夏云溪有气无力地推开林风眠。
“师兄，过了，不能再继续了！”
林风眠看着眼前衣衫凌乱、欲拒还迎的美人，差点把持不住。
果然，地大物博还是很难的！
他以大毅力大智慧才压下心中的绮念，艰难地松开夏云溪。
“云溪，你怎么样？”
“我没事。”
夏云溪红着脸整理着被弄乱的衣衫，遮住那乍泄的春光。
片刻后，她期待地看着林风眠。
“师兄，你修为有没有提升？”
林风眠运转功法，激动地点头道：“有！”
“太好了！”
夏云溪小脸上洋溢着笑容，看上去倒是比林风眠还激动。
“接下来师兄你每天来红鸾峰找我，我助你提升修为。”
她倒不是不想让林风眠一次吸个够，只是这样会损伤她的道基。
一旦被宗门长辈发现，不仅是她，连林风眠也会有麻烦。
林风眠嗯了一声，问道：“师妹，这次考核除了修为还有什么要求吗？”
夏云溪笑道：“这次下山是为了迷惑外人，所以对外在形象有一定要求。”
“师兄你长相俊朗，又出身书香世家，这方面一定没问题的！”
林风眠长舒一口气，这方面他的确有优势！
看着夏云溪，他动容道：“云溪，这回真是多亏你了！”
夏云溪嫣然一笑道：“师兄不用这么见外的。”
林风眠看着她，迟疑道：“我能为你做些什么吗？”
夏云溪看着他，似乎想说什么，最后还是改口了。
“师兄若是离开玉仙宗，有机会便替我去看一下我父母吧！”
林风眠嗯了一声，询问道：“云溪，你家在哪里？”
夏云溪如实相告：“燕国滨城！”
林风眠想了想，发现这是赵国的邻国，不由有些好奇。
“云溪，你怎么会加入玉仙宗？”
夏云溪闻言愣了一下，轻声道：“我是被爹娘送进玉仙宗的。”
林风眠义愤填膺道：“你也是被玉仙宗骗进来的？”
content_en:
After a while, Xia Yunxi weakly pushed Lin Fengmian away.
"Senior brother, it's over, we can't continue!"
Lin Fengmian almost couldn't control himself when he looked at the disheveled beauty in front of him who was trying to resist but still wanted to welcome her.
Sure enough, it is still difficult to have abundant resources in the vast land!
He used great perseverance and wisdom to suppress the thoughts in his heart and let go of Xia Yunxi with difficulty.
"Yunxi, how are you?"
"I'm fine."
Xia Yunxi blushed and straightened her messed up clothes to cover up her sudden release.
After a moment, she looked at Lin Fengmian expectantly.
"Senior brother, has your cultivation level improved?"
Lin Fengmian activated his skills and nodded excitedly: "Yes!"
"Great!"
Xia Yunxi's face was filled with a smile, and she looked even more excited than Lin Fengmian.
"Senior brother, come to Hongluan Peak to see me every day, and I will help you improve your cultivation."
It wasn't that she didn't want Lin Fengmian to suck enough at one time, but it would damage her Daoji.
Once discovered by the elders of the sect, not only her, but also Lin Fengmian would be in trouble.
Lin Fengmian hummed and asked, "Junior sister, are there any other requirements for this assessment besides cultivation?"
Xia Yunxi smiled and said: "This time I went down the mountain to confuse outsiders, so I have certain requirements for my external image."
"Senior brother, you are handsome and come from a scholarly family, so you will be fine in this respect!"
Lin Fengmian breathed a sigh of relief. He did have an advantage in this regard!
Looking at Xia Yunxi, he said with emotion: "Yunxi, it's really thanks to you this time!"
Xia Yunxi smiled sweetly and said, "Senior brother, you don't have to be so outspoken."
Lin Fengmian looked at her and said hesitantly: "What can I do for you?"
Xia Yunxi looked at him, as if she wanted to say something, but finally changed her mind.
"If senior brother leaves the Jade Immortal Sect, please visit my parents for me if you have the chance!"
Lin Fengmian hummed and asked, "Yunxi, where is your home?"
Xia Yunxi told the truth: "Bincheng of Yan State!"
Lin Fengmian thought about it and realized that this was Zhao's neighboring country, and he couldn't help but be curious.
"Yunxi, why did you join the Jade Immortal Sect?"
Xia Yunxi was stunned for a moment when he heard this, and said softly: "I was sent to the Jade Immortal Sect by my parents."
Lin Fengmian said indignantly: "Were you also tricked into joining the Jade Immortal Sect?"
